LOGISTIC S SERVICE S AGREEMENT 
 
 This Logistic s Service s Agreement (“ Agreement ”) is entered into on this 14 day of April 2021 (“ Effective Date ”) by and between:

Alam Extension Road, Lahore, Pakistan, acting through its authorized representative, Mr. Umair Munir (hereinafter referred to as “OLX” which expression shall, where the context so permits, be deemed to mean and includes its successors-in-interest, administrators and assigns) of the First Part

 (Each a “Party” and collectively “Parties” ). 
 
 WHEREAS : 
 
 The Service Provider has expertise and experience in providing logistics and related services (as described below in detail ) ; and 
 
 The Service Provider intends to provide and OLX intends to utilize the services offered by the Service Provider and the Parties are entering into this Agreement for the provision of such services to OLX subject to the terms and conditions hereof. 
 
 DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS 
 
 Unless inconsistent with the context, the following words shall have the meaning assigned below:

 “Applicable Law” means any law, proclamation, decree, ministerial decision, statute, statutory instrument, order, regulation, resolution, notice, legal precedent, by-law, directive, treaty or other instrument or requirement having the force of law within Pakistan and issued, declared, passed or given effect in any manner by any government authority; 
 
 “Business Day” means every day of the week except Sundays and public holidays in Pakistan on which banks in which the Parties have account(s) are open for general banking business; 
 
 “Cash on Delivery (COD)” means the payment method under which the Consignee makes payment of the invoice value of the Consignment , through cash, upon delivery of the Consignment ; 
 
 “Claim” shall mean any and all foreseeable or unforeseeable, known and unknown, suspected and unsuspected, disclosed and undisclosed, alleged or actual and consequential action of whatsoever nature, cause of action (whether in tort, agreement or strict liability, and whether in law, equity, statutory or otherwise), claim, demand, lawsuit, legal proceeding, administrative or other proceedings or litigation;

 “Consignment” means the goods in respect of which the Service Provider shall provide the Services;

 “Events of Default” has the meaning assigned to it in C lause 18 ;

 “Losses” shall mean any and all damages (including, without limitation, direct, consequential, economic, exemplary, future, incidental, indirect, noneconomic, past, special and punitive), sanctions, settlement payments, disbursements, judgments, liability, losses (including lost income or profit), costs or expenses of any nature whatsoever, whether accrued, absolute, contingent or otherwise, including, without limitation, attorneys’ fees and costs (whether or not a proceeding is initiated); 
 
 “OLX” means Online Classifieds Pakistan (SMC-Private) Limited; 
 
 “Prohibited Products” means the goods that are prohibited from being transported in terms of this Agreement or under Applicable Laws;

 “ Service Fee ” has the meaning assigned to it in C lause 5; 
 
 “Taxes” means any direct and indirect federal, provincial or local taxes, duties, cess, fees, levies or charges of whatsoever nature payable with respect to the Services, as may be prescribed or levied from time to time under any Applicable Law;

 SCOPE 
 
 OLX hereby appoints the Service Provider to provide the S ervices and the Service Provider hereby accepts such appointment to perform the S ervices for the Service Fee stipulated in Clause 5 in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement . 
 
 PROVISION OF SERVICES 
 
 The Service Provider shall provide the Services in such geographical locations as notified by OLX, in writing, from time to time. 
 
 The Service Provider shall provide such other additional services as part of the Services as are required to be provided , from time to time, for the purposes of efficient delivery of Services. 
 
 In furtherance to Clause 3.2 , the Parties shall agree , in writing, upon any extra remuneration / consideration for the additional services to be provided by the Service Provider . 
 
 NON-EXCLUSIVITY 
 
 The Parties agree that the Services are being provided on non- exclusive basis . The Service Provider may render similar services for others and OLX shall be free to engage other logistics service s providers to perform the services covered under this Agreement. 
 
 SERVICE FEE 
 
 As consideration for performance of the Services, the Service Provider shall be entitled to and OLX shall be liable to pay to the Service Provider , the Service Fee which shall be calculated in accordance with the rates mentioned in Annexure B (“ Service Fee ”) . 
 
 Payment of Service Fee shall be subject to deduction and adjustments in accordance with the terms and conditions of the Agreement and any Taxes in accordance with the Applicable L aws . 
 
 PAYMENT 
 
 The Service Provider shall invoice OLX, on monthly basis, for the Service Fee. OLX shall pay and clear all such invoices, within fifteen (15) days of the date of such invoice . 
 
 OLX shall notify, in writing, the Service Provider of any dispute , discrepancy or objection in respect of any invoice within five (5) working days from the receipt of such invoice . On being notified, t h e Service Provider shall issue revised invoice containing necessary changes / alterations . 
 
 REIMBURSEMENT OF COD AMOUNT 
 
 For all COD Consignments, COD amount shall be collected by the Service Provider. 
 
 OLX shall invoice the Service Provider for the COD amount and the Service Provider shall, within three (3) working days of such invoice , reimburse the COD amount to OLX through bank transfer. 
 
 PARTIES’ OBLIGATIONS 
 
 The Service Provider shall be solely responsible and liable for the performance of the Services and for ensuring/procuring the performance of the Services as required by OLX. 
 
 Except as otherwise expressly provided in this Agreement, the Service Provider shall be solely responsible for providing all facilities, personnel, and other resources necessary for the provision of the Services, and incurring all costs and expenses related or ancillary therewith. 
 
 The Service Provider hereby agrees, undertakes and covenants that it shall be solely responsible for the Consignment from the time of i ts pick-up from the specified pick-up location till the time of its delivery to the stated destination . Any damage to the Consign ment or any part thereof, whether due to any act, error or omission of the Service Provider (including its personnel) or of any third party, shall be the sole responsibility of the Service Provider. The Service Provider hereby agrees to indemnify OLX, in full, for any Loss incurred by OLX as a consequence of any damage to the Consign ment . The Service Provider hereby grants OLX the right to deduct the amount of such Loss from the Service Fee prior to remittance of the Service Fee to the Service Provider. 
 
 OLX shall be liable to provide true, accurate, current and complete details with respect to the products in the shipment / consignment note. 
 
 OLX shall, at its sole responsibility, properly pack age and mark each Consignment to ensure its safe handling and delivery in accordance with the Applicable Laws. 
 
 WARRANTIES AND REPRESENTATIONS 
 
 Each Party hereby represents and warrants to the other Party as follows:- 
 
 The Party is duly organized and validly existing under the Applicable Laws and the Party has full power and authority to perform its obligations hereunder. 
 
 The Parties have the legal right, capacity, power and authority to enter into this Agreement and the Parties’ entry into and performance under the Agreement and the transactions contemplated by it do not constitute a breach of any Applicable Law, or any obligation or default of any contract or license by which they are so bound. 
 
 In addition to the covenants, representations and warranties (express or implied) contained elsewhere in the Agreement , the Service Provider hereby warrants, represents, undertakes and acknowledges that :- 
 The Service Provider has obtained and shall maintain and comply with the requirements of all requisite consents, permits, permissions, authorizations, approvals, NOCs, declarations, registrations, certifications, waivers, exemptions and/or licenses required under the Applicable Laws with respect to the provision of services of the nature and type contemplated under this Agreement . 
 
 The Service Provider is in complete compliance with all laws, rules and regulations of federal, state or local entities which may have jurisdiction over Leopard Logistics such that any failure of compliance will not have an adverse effect on the Leopard Logistics’ ability to enter, execute, deliver or consummate this Agreement. 
 
 The Service Provider shall provide and perform the Services promptly and in a proper and efficient manner and in the manner agreed to in this Agreement . 
 
 The Service Provider has required professional expertise, organisation , skill, training, experience, technical know-how, sufficient capacity and resources including machinery, equipment, vehicles, personnel etc., necessary for the effective performance of its obligations under this Agreement to the satisfaction of OLX . 
 
 The Service Provider shall employ able, skilled, efficient and experienced personnel to perform the Services in accordance with this Agreement . 
 
 The Service Provider and its personnel shall ensure that the work is conducted in a cost-efficient manner, through inter alia effective deployment and use of resources. 
 
 The Service Provider shall ensure that its personnel adhere to and abide by the guidelines, instructions and directions communicated to it by OLX from time to time . 
 
 The Service Provider , its subcontractors, suppliers, vendors and agents involved in the provision of Services shall comply with the Applicable Laws with respect to the operation of their facilities and their business and labor practices, including without limitation working conditions, wages, hours and minimum age of workers. 
 
 It is OLX’s policy to prohibit and actively pursue the prevention of money laundering and any activity that facilitates money laundering or the financing or of terrorist or criminal activities. OLX is committed to anti-money laundering compliance in accordance with Applicable Law and requires the Service Provider to adhere to these standards and prevent the use of its Products for money laundering purposes. The Service Provider warrants that the Service Provider is not, in any way, directly or indirectly involved in money laundering or financing of terrorist or criminal activities or any other illegal activity. OLX reserves the right to carry out necessary money laundering, terrorism financing, fraud or any other illegal activity check before authorizing payment of Service Fee. 
 
 OLX may at any point require the Service Provider to provide any financial, business information related to the Services on a case-to-case basis and the Service Provider shall provide the same to OLX within seven (7) Business Days of such request being made. 
 
 The Service Provider shall remain liable for the actions of and be responsible for the supervision of each of its executives, officers, directors, employees, agents, representatives, suppliers, vendors, agents and subcontractors. The Service Provider shall ensure and procure that each of its executives, directors, employees, consultants , agents, representatives, suppliers, vendors, agents and subcontractors are bound by this Agreement and Applicable Law including but not limited to with respect to Intellectual Property, Confidential Information, anti-money laundering, anti-bribery and anti-corruption. 
 
 The Service Provider is solvent, able to pay its debts and is and shall remain a going business concern. 
 
 No insolvency proceeding of any character, including, without limitation, bankruptcy, receivership, reorganization, composition or arrangement with creditors, voluntary or involuntary, affecting the Service Provider, is pending or, to the knowledge of the Service Provider, threatened. The Service Provider has not taken any action in contemplation of, or that would constitute the basis for, the institution of any such insolvency proceedings. 
 
 The Service Provider is in material compliance with all Applicable Laws which may have any bearing on its ability to perform the Services and general obligations under this Agreement and it shall continue to comply with all Applicable Laws now or hereafter having jurisdiction over the Services and/or those performing the same. 
 
 There are no proceedings against the Service Provider, pending or threatened, that could adversely affect the performance of the Service Provider’s obligations under the Agreement. 
 
 To inform OLX immediately , in writing , of any change in the particulars of the Service Provider including but not limited to business name, brand name, address, temporary or permanent closure of its office and/or business activities. 
 
 The Service Provider shall use reasonable skill, care and diligence in the performance of its obligations under this Agreement . 
 
 The Service Provider shall not, during or after termination of the Agreement, engage in conduct or make any representation that injures, harms, corrupts, demeans, disparages, defames, destroys or diminishes, or would reasonably be expected so to do, in any way the reputation or goodwill of OLX, its directors, officers, employees or agents or any of its affiliated, subsidiary or holding companies. 
 The Service Provider shall in performing its obligations under the Agreement, in accordance with : good industry practices, Applicable Laws and the terms and conditions of this Agreement . 
 
 The Service Provider shall execute and deliver all such other instruments and take all such other actions as may reasonably be required from time to time in order to effectuate the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement.
